Class H3Cell

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.database.H3Cell
@Entity public class H3Cell extends Object

H3Cell

JPA Entity representing an H3 hexagonal cell.
Stores terrain, climate, ecological, demographic, and socio-economic tensor data for a single hexagonal cell. Ingests global planetary datasets (NOAA ETOPO, WorldClim, UNESCO WHYMAP, Natural Earth, Seshat, D-PLACE) into standardized H3 hexagonal rasters.

Analytical equations (movement friction, dynamic surface albedo, 7-cohort demographic age pyramid, metabolic subsistence needs, 3D surface area, and DOD component transformations) are delegated to H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.

Since:
1.0.0
Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
